front: Four stages of the business cycle?

back: A period when GDP falls, incomes and spending fall and unemployment rises.

front: Effects of a boom on business?
back: High sales and profit, but rising costs and wages, skills shortages and stretched capacity.

front: How do businesses respond to a recession?
back: Cut costs, cheaper products, protect cash (less stock, chase debts), new markets, diversify.
A sustained rise in the general level of prices, reducing the purchasing power of money.
Higher costs, harder planning, falling real incomes of customers, less competitive exports.

front: Effects of rising unemployment on business?
back: Lower demand (especially luxuries) but easier recruitment and smaller wage rises.

front: Which firms suffer most in a recession?
back: Sellers of luxuries and expensive durable goods (cars, furniture, holidays).
An increase in a country's real GDP (total output of goods and services).
